structs.notes: The Replay PartyData is 373704 bytes (proven). partyMembers is 200 x 488 at 2192. The rest of the struct from subparties on is laid out by raw Replay offsets above, not by IDA's old layout: IDA's old pads and the 3224-byte shift (subparties at 107752 vs gt 110976) account for almost all the size difference; the tail from partyStateData (311216) onward keeps a -3384 shift with a few fields moved. Session, migrateData and requestBuffer (0..2192) were not checked.
